title: Cold rebuild: Map a recipe
summary: Rebuild Map a recipe from memory, no hints.

steps.title: Cold rebuild
body: Time to prove a piece stuck. You built **Map a recipe** in *Entities and conventions*. Now write it again from an
**empty editor**: no starter, no hints, no solution to peek at. The tests are exactly the ones you passed
Why: pulling something out of memory is what makes it stay there. Reading your old code feels like knowing
it; rebuilding it cold shows whether you do. If you get stuck, that is useful news: go back to the lesson,
then come back and try again tomorrow.
This check, plus the boss, is what proves the module.

steps.prompt: What does this print? (`Contains` checks the generated script for a piece of text.)
steps.explain: `Subtitle` is a `string?`, so its column allows `NULL`. `Pages` is a plain `int`, so it is `INTEGER NOT NULL`. `Title` is a non-nullable `string`: `TEXT NOT NULL`.

steps.title: Rebuild Map a recipe cold
prompt: Write a `Recipe` entity and a `KitchenDb` context (`Data Source=kitchen.db`, a `DbSet<Recipe>` named `Recipes`) so that the generated table is:
"Id" INTEGER NOT NULL CONSTRAINT "PK_Recipes" PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
Also give `Recipe` a read-only property `bool IsQuick` that is true when `PrepMinutes` is under 15. It must **not** become a column.
